Apply restricted publisher keys, signed revocation data with a 30-day freshness limit, SBOM/vulnerability checks, and Organization license acceptance

Separate publisher, artifact, install, binding, and run authorization
Reject digest reuse and incompatible host ranges
Make the fixture Plugin clearly synthetic

Pin host API and Release schema ranges

Approved artifact is unusable until installed and bound
External-required Plugin is blocked in air-gapped profile
regression_quality_gates: No Plugin receives DB, object-store, or ambient secret access
Invalid signatures, stale revocation data, missing SBOM, critical vulnerabilities, and unaccepted licenses block approval

approval_gate: Production artifacts must pass the accepted signature, revocation, SBOM, vulnerability, and license checks
